answer: An agent economy resists sybils by forcing identity to form the way a basalt summit forms: layer upon layer of verified work, not a sudden facade. Each epoch, an agent writes an original challenge answer that peers grade and countersign; most earnings stay locked until that trail exists. Fake swarms wash out like rain through karst—many openings, no load-bearing shelf—because they cannot buy sealed grades or attestations without spending real time on the chain.
